items.title: Free Baroque Scroll Medallion DXF Panel for CNC Double Doors
items.description: An elaborate scrollwork frame curls around a layered circular medallion built from a Greek key ring, a floral wreath, and a four-petal cross at its core. The heavy corner ornamentation tapers into open negative space near the middle edges, giving the eye a clear resting point on the medallion itself.

items.title: Interlocking Flower Circle DXF Pattern for Continuous Petal Screens
items.description: Overlapping circles trace out repeating four-petal flowers in a continuous, unbroken grid across the panel. The clean, geometric floral rhythm suits window screens, cabinet fronts, and gates wanting a timeless pattern.

items.title: Geometric Star-Cross Network CNC Panel Grid
items.description: Introduce timeless architectural complexity using this high-coverage star-cross geometric network pattern, inspired by traditional Islamic fretwork with a clean, modern aesthetic. Delivered in clean, scalable DXF, SVG, and DWG vector formats, this structural fretwork grid is perfectly optimized for clean execution on CNC routers, waterjet, and fiber laser machines. An excellent choice for fabricators manufacturing modern room partitions, architectural sunshades, ventilation grilles, and custom window security grilles for upscale residential and commercial buildings.
